critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all viewports: LCP is 548–704 ms, FCP 52–76 ms, TTFB 1.3–5.8 ms, and load completes in 141–237 ms. CLS is excellent on mobile (0) and desktop (0.0011), and acceptable on tablet (0.0478). No console, page, or request failures occurred; all sampled API calls returned 200. Mobile/tablet frames held about 16.67 ms with no long frames. The main limitations are the 1.31 MB transfer, 1.15 MB of JavaScript, and slower desktop frame average of 20.73 ms despite no long frames.
critique.fix: Trim or code-split the 1.15 MB JavaScript payload, then profile the desktop rendering path to sustain a 16.7 ms frame cadence. Reserve responsive element dimensions to reduce tablet CLS toward zero.
